title: Using polynomial commitments to replace state roots

posts.raw: To prove $f_1(x_1) = y_1, \ldots, f_k(x_k) = y_k$, first let $F = (f_1 - y_1) \cdot \prod_{i \ne 1} (X - x_i) + \ldots$
Witness sizes shrink dramatically under this scheme.
